name: Mina Manyhandles
props: small clay storage jar with absurdly many chunky handles
visual: low broad splat, one eyelid twitching, tight closed grimace
personality: Has a handle on everything except the inventory.
biography: Every awkward HyperNorm card gets a jar; the Men in Black have requested more handles.
note: FrizzleBob: The container can be carried by a committee.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Theo Almostbull
props: small padded bull-horn-shaped practice grip held at belly
visual: tall thin curving blob, enormous wary eyes, a tiny round toothless gasp
personality: Performs confidence several seconds before acquiring it.
biography: Hunky and Dory schedule his bravery between two public demonstrations of certainty.
note: FrizzleBob: He has negotiated a smaller rehearsal bull.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Bram Bluecurl
props: round marine-style flask with a simple curled octopus motif and short brush
visual: round heavy bean, one sleepy eye and one checking eye, closed wry smirk
personality: Signs every commission with an extra tentacle.
biography: He paints over unwanted cards and keeps finding the covered stories in his sea creatures.
note: FrizzleBob: The octopus has submitted a ninth revision.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Dorian Softbronze
props: tiny figure-eight shield and very short blunt bronze spear
visual: wide soft hourglass splat, elevated outraged brows, a tight lower-lip pout
personality: Regrets being assigned the ceremonial entrance.
biography: He guards a HyperNorm doorway that reconstruction moves every morning.
note: FrizzleBob: The post is permanent. Its location is seasonal.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Faye Frescowet
props: shallow blue pigment dish and broad stubby brush
visual: asymmetric droplet with a wide flat base, dreamy cross-directed eyes, crooked open two-tooth laugh
personality: Would happily repaint the end of the world.
biography: She makes each restored facade more reassuring, then leaves one unsettling blue wave.
calls: A fresh coat will explain it.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Niko Tiedcargo
props: small rope-bound amphora-shaped jar with a short folded sailcloth
visual: slumped chunky oval, low lids, thin deeply downturned closed mouth
personality: Has carried the same urgent delivery since the last era.
biography: The Men in Black call his sealed cargo normality; he calls it heavy.
note: FrizzleBob: Fragile is the heaviest shipping class.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
